<div class="card-body">
'''R2 Sensor Array''' is a [[Light]] [[Device]] ([[Item]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">R2のセンサー・アレイ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">任意のRユニット・ドロイドに配備する。同じ場所にいる自分のキャラクターは、生物の攻撃からリアクションとして移動して逃げることができる。加えて、同じ位置か隣接位置で捜索隊の運命数に3を加える。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-R2-Sensor-Array-PSA-85187818.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ごく一般的な、インダストリアル・オートマトン製のR2用追加装置。放射線の強度や附近の生命体の存在などを感知できる。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' R2 Sensor Array.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy on any R-unit droid. Your character at the same place may move and flee as a react from a creature attack. Also, add 3 to search party destiny at the same or adjacent location.

'''Lore:'''
A very common R2 accessory made by Industrial Automaton. It can sense radiation strength and nearby life-forms.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed title is R2のセンサー・アレイ.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[R2 Sensor Array]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
